crossRefs.note: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, the cave which was in it, and all…

people.name: Heth
people.line: Son of Canaan and ancestor of the Hittites.

translations.web: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.”
translations.bsb: The field and the cave that is in it were purchased from the Hittites.”
translations.kjv: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.
translations.asv: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.
